background: Britannica（B346）：'Chicago'——'Hog Butcher, Tool Maker, Stacker of Wheat, Player with Railroads and Freight Handler to the Nation'——城市即工人、机器与肉。

工人、钢铁与'人民'的抒情（B346 语系）。

以人炼钢（B346：'they make their steel with men'）。
